title: ApprovalDecision
description: Payload for approval decision commands and recorded events across promotion, pinning, and operator actions

approval_id.description: Unique identifier of the approval aggregate

target_id.description: Domain entity identifier (e.g. promotion_id, sku, action_id)

decision_state.description: Deterministic lifecycle state of the approval aggregate

actor_ref.description: Actor identity or system component performing the decision

expected_resource_version.description: Optimistic concurrency version of the approval aggregate

decided_at.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp when decision was made

decided_at_ms.description: Exact integer epoch milliseconds (Article V zero-float invariant)

expires_at.description: RFC3339 UTC expiration timestamp for time-bounded approvals

reason.description: Optional or mandatory rationale for rejection/revocation

evidence_ids.description: Traceable audit and policy evidence IDs grounding this approval
